mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weekly_work_schedule ( employee_id, start_date, end_date, approval_status, plan_date, work_form, schedule_title, memo, created_at ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{approvalStatus}, #{planDate}, #{workForm}, #{scheduleTitle}, #{memo}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT weekly_id as weeklyId, employee_id as employeeId, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, approval_status as approvalStatus, plan_date as planDate, work_form as workForm, schedule_title as scheduleTitle, memo as memo, created_at as createdAt, update_at as updatedAt FROM weekly_work_schedule WHERE weekly_id = #{weeklyId}

SELECT weekly_id as weeklyId, employee_id as employeeId, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, approval_status as approvalStatus, plan_date as planDate, work_form as workForm, schedule_title as scheduleTitle, memo as memo, created_at as createdAt, update_at as updatedAt FROM weekly_work_schedule WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE weekly_work_schedule SET approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, update_at = NOW() WHERE weekly_id = #{weeklyId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) as pendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) as approvedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) as rejectedCount FROM weekly_work_schedule WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
